doc.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Choosing musicians when she leads a gig
summary: Rossano Sportiello versus John DiMartino: she picks from a pool of players depending on what the gig calls for.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: Well when you book your own gigs as a leader, I’m curious about your phone book or whatever. Do you have indicators of —
But you probably have people that you want to call in a certain order.

And sometimes for me it’s about the gig. Sometimes I think it might be a gig where they want it more traditional. So sometimes I might hire Rossano Sportiello over John DiMartino, do you know what I mean? It depends musically on what they want sometimes too. I kind of have a pool of musicians I try to get, basically.
